title: AHAH for SQL Server
description: A CLI pipeline that puts every edition of the Access to Healthy Assets and Hazards index (AHAH, versions 1 to 5.1, Geographic Data Science Lab, University of Liverpool, hosted by the Geographic Data Service) for Scottish data zones into one SQL Server table, values exactly as published, from hash-pinned sources, with a row digest that a load is checked against. AHAH is published under the Open Government Licence v3.0; cite Daras et al. 2019, doi:10.1038/s41597-019-0114-6.
